existingDispositions.rationale: Cultural authority legitimacy and individual credibility are distinct levels; credential cue is not randomly assigned cultural norm.
Objective methodological evidence quality is not pretested subjective argument strength.
Traceability permits checking; discovered poor source or failure may reduce credibility.
Material omission is RDS ratio over a reference universe; perceptual sufficiency requires recipient detection/knowledge.
Prior INF-F03 revision proposal separates uncertainty disclosure, credibility and calibration; this Layer review references it only.
Resistance motivation and generated counterarguments can be related but successful resistance is not a direct motivation measure.
Trait/situational desire for closure may alter search thresholds, but stopping does not establish judged adequacy.
Objective reliability must be experienced/attributed before trust; automation reliance is not specific-source epistemic generalization.
Synthetic-versus-real face category is not independently manipulated fidelity or source credibility for a claim.
Existing authorized uncertainty-disclosure→source-credibility claim is explicitly context-dependent/nonmonotonic with bounded surveyed factual/numerical message scope.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Source credibility is factual accuracy or confidence calibration.

gapQuestions.rationale: Specified-source generalization versus broader vulnerability/reliance and trait stance differ.

gapQuestions.rationale: Sensitivity/calibration and mean confidence can dissociate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Forewarning always increases resistance.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Inoculation→threat→counterarguments→resistance is an identified pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Package, coded moderators, correlated mediators and outcomes do not identify transmitted effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reduced attitude change is Resistance Motivation itself.
gapQuestions.rationale: Successful outcome not independent underlying motivation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Providing previously omitted opposing arguments changes perceived sufficiency.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA28; composite adequacy and confidence/recommendation outcomes differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Less actual information necessarily lowers perceived sufficiency.
gapQuestions.rationale: Partial-information adequacy did not decline in one controlled scenario.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Perceived sufficiency equals actual requirement-set completeness.
gapQuestions.rationale: Recipient judgment differs from calculated ratio; no RDS identity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Replication success/failure disclosure changes source credibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Positive/negative researcher trust dimensions, whole-profile scope not normalized.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Every provenance disclosure increases credibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Bad results/untrusted sources can lower it.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Synthetic-media fidelity changes perceived source credibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Face type/trustworthiness is not exact fidelity manipulation or claim-source profile.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Decision-aid reliability increases epistemic trust.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing edge review only; exact generalizable willingness rather than reliance/performance needed.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Biological noradrenergic manipulation changes confidence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Metacognitive sensitivity improved but mean confidence did not; no dose/recommendation or general confidence benefit.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reduced sampling under drug means greater perceived sufficiency.
gapQuestions.rationale: Sampling behavior and modeled urgency not direct subjective adequacy.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A fitted urgency model is empirical observation of a psychological state.
gapQuestions.rationale: Model-inferred mechanism not direct measured cause.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Need for Cognition modifies REL-INF-037 or REL-PSY-051.
gapQuestions.rationale: Theoretical condition/scale not exact-edge independently evidenced modifier; F14 consultation required.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Authority culture independently increases source credibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Group norm/individual exposure and shared measurement require cross-level evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Therapeutic mentalizing improves epistemic trust.
gapQuestions.rationale: Framework and general stance validation not exact controlled source-specific effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Trust, mistrust and credulity are one reverse-scored scalar.
gapQuestions.rationale: Three correlated factors distinct; trust not simply low credulity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Objective evidence quality increases perceived argument strength.
gapQuestions.rationale: Actual independent quality differs from pretested subjective weak/strong argument contrast.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Bogus thought-label feedback changes actual counterargument production.
gapQuestions.rationale: Thoughts generated before labels; perceived type and actual count/quality differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Environmental stress or informational scarcity changes confidence/trust.
gapQuestions.rationale: Scenario water shortage not actual environmental exposure; no exact direct physical effect retained.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Credible-source intervention changes all Psychological outcomes.
gapQuestions.rationale: Behavior synthesis not direct credibility manipulation efficacy across constructs; intervention/source identity differ.
